svg.title: Adult START disaster triage
svg.desc: Assess walking, breathing after airway repositioning, respiratory rate, perfusion and command-following. Loudness alone never determines a tag. Reassess and follow the adopted local algorithm.
svg.text: Adult START: assess before assigning a tag
For a mass-casualty incident using START; use the local adopted protocol.
Able to walk → initial GREEN group; reassess for hidden injury.
2 · If not breathing, reposition the airway
Still apneic → BLACK under the adult START pathway.
3 · For a patient who is breathing, assess RPM
Perfusion: absent radial pulse or refill over 2 seconds → RED.
Mental status: cannot follow a simple command → RED.
Continue reassessment; a tag can change as findings or resources change.
Screaming or silence alone does not determine a category.
SALT is a different algorithm; it separates dead from expectant.
Source: HHS CHEMM · Adult START triage
